decision.outcome: Keep applyProjectOnly as-is; no code removal. spec.md's acceptance criterion revised to state applyProjectOnly is retained by design (it still gates provider-identity resolution) rather than eliminated.
decision.rationale: User decision (recorded 2026-08-25): applyProjectOnly is still functionally necessary to prevent a mismatched local profile's credentials leaking onto a different active global profile; the original AC's wording to eliminate it did not account for this, so the AC text was corrected instead of removing needed logic.
